notes.subject: והמטים עקלקלותם
notes.rationale: 'ol i go long ol rot bilong ol i tanim tok' — literal 'those who bend their crooked ways'

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i laikimObjekt pronoun; Hibru i no gat em

notes.subject: יוליכם
notes.rationale: 'salim ol i go wantaim' (lead away with) vs 'banisim' (banish, BSB); causative of ילך

notes.subject: שלום על ישראל
notes.rationale: benediksen bilong psalm; 'Solwara... pinga...' em i tok bilong greting stret long Tok Pisin, wankain olsem שלום

translation: Ol i go long ol rot bilong ol i tanim tok, Yahwe bai salim ⟨em⟩ ol i go wantaim ⟨את⟩ ol man i wokim nogut. Solwara... pinga...

tokens.gloss: ol rot bilong ol i tanim tok
